---
title: Complex Portal
description: Curated and predicted macromolecular complexes from EMBL-EBI's Complex Portal, with one row per participant.
---

[Complex Portal](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal) (EMBL-EBI) describes
stable macromolecular complexes: a named assembly, its participants and their
stoichiometry, a GO annotation and the evidence. That is a different shape
from a binary interaction, so it has its own two tables rather than rows in
`annotation.interaction`. It is released with IntAct under a dated directory;
the date is the version. Every ComplexTab file of the release lands, one per
species plus the human hu.MAP predictions; the file name is what says
"predicted".

## Licence and citation

CC0 1.0. Cite [Complex Portal](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/about) as
EMBL-EBI asks.

## Join keys

- The complex AC (`CPX-663`) is the key, unique across curated and predicted files; `annotation.complexportal__participant.complex_ac` joins it.
- Participants stay in Complex Portal's identifier space, with the namespace read off the id: UniProtKB (98%), ChEBI, a `CPX-` sub-complex, RNAcentral, IntAct. Join UniProt accessions through `annotation.identifier_mapping` (human only so far).
- A molecule set (interchangeable paralogs filling one position) becomes one row per member, with the set kept beside it.

## Good to know

- GO annotations, cross-references, ligands and disease stay on the complex row as the published `|`-separated strings.
- The expanded participant list, which flattens sub-complexes, stays in raw.
